name: kinetic-toast
title: Kinetic Toast
author: Feldrok
description: A physics-based toast notification component for React, installed like shadcn/ui Sonner.
docs: Add the component, then import `Toaster` from your shadcn UI path (for example `@/components/ui/kinetic-toast`) and render it once in your app layout. Trigger notifications from client components with `kinetic.success({ title: "Saved" })`. The wrapper maps `--popover` / `--popover-foreground` onto `--kinetic-toast-fill` / `--kinetic-toast-fg` / `--kinetic-toast-fg-muted`, so toasts inherit your app theme automatically. Toggling `.dark` on `html` or `body` (next-themes, Tailwind class mode, your own state) flips the toast surface with no JS dependency. The wrapper imports colocated CSS for Sonner-like one-step setup. If a legacy Next.js Pages Router app rejects this CSS import, move it to `pages/_app.tsx`.
